What we set up for Saudi Arabia

Saudi buyers expect Arabic first, fast mobile pages and familiar payment methods like Mada. Riyadh is the most competitive city; Jeddah and the Eastern Province still have room to grow.

Cities for local SEORiyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Mecca, Medina and Khobar
PaymentsMada, STC Pay, Apple Pay, and Tabby or Tamara
CurrencySaudi riyal (SAR)
Domain.sa or .com
LanguagesArabic-first sites with an English version for international partners.
Data protectionWe follow the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law, overseen by SDAIA, including notices and data handling for forms and chat.

Questions

Can you integrate Mada and STC Pay?

Yes. Mada and STC Pay are standard on our Saudi e-commerce builds.

Is the site Arabic-first?

Yes. For Saudi businesses we design in Arabic first and add English as a full second version.

Do we need to meet in person?

No. Everything, from the first call to launch and support, is done online. In-person support is available on the Trade & Export and Enterprise packages if you want it.

How do we pay?

In USDT (Tether) on TRC-20 or ERC-20. Local and Trade: half to start, half at launch. Enterprise: per approved milestone.
